items.text: 49ers WR Mike Evans has hip injury and is questionable to return today; Shanahan says doesn't look serious.
items.why: In-game; Rapoport notes Shanahan not serious + Robinson high ankle.
items.implication: Possible limited or out remainder; Kittle/others targets up.
items.opportunity: Increased looks for remaining SF WRs/TE if sits.

items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels ruled OUT with left elbow injury (dislocated per Quinn); carted, prior similar missed 4 games; further testing Monday.
items.why: In-game cart and official rule-out; Rapoport corroborates awkward bend.
items.implication: Immediate WAS offense collapse; backup QB starts remainder; ROS concern.
items.opportunity: Possible elevated checkdowns to McLaurin/Samuel/Goedert but overall volume down.

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams suffered hamstring injury; walking under own power later, tests tomorrow.
items.why: Official Bears report; Rapoport notes walking good spirits better than alternatives.
items.implication: Monitor severity for ROS/next week; possible limited or backup.
items.opportunity: If limited/out, Bagent or run-heavy; skill players (Moore/Odunze/Burden) docks.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey is active today after cracked rib injury and GTD status with optimism and flak jacket possible.
items.why: Official inactive list confirmation; Rapoport earlier noted optimism and improved practice.
items.implication: Start with docks possible for limited snaps/effectiveness; no major beneficiary reverse.
items.opportunity: Primary WR role targets if full go; flak jacket may limit physicality.

items.text: Broncos RB RJ Harvey is inactive today due to hamstring.
items.why: Official confirmation matching ETR/Levitan not expected and Berry grab Coleman note.
items.implication: Opens backfield looks; handcuff/upgrade for backups.
items.opportunity: Increased carries/snaps for residual RBs like J.K. Dobbins complement or rookie Jonah Coleman.

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley (stinger) is questionable to return today.
items.implication: Monitor return; if out rest of game, Gainwell elevated.
items.opportunity: Kenny Gainwell snap/carry surge if inactive remainder.

items.text: Seahawks rookie RB Jadarian Price questionable to return due to chest injury.
items.implication: Monitor; if out, other SEA RBs elevated.

items.text: Ladd McConkey officially ACTIVE. RJ Harvey inactive; grab Jonah Coleman now if ignored preseason. Agrees Bernard stash (YAC/McCarthy fit) with Pittman out.
items.why: Confirms statuses + preseason stash advice for Coleman; Bernard YAC fit.
items.implication: Start McConkey; add Coleman/Bernard in deeper leagues.
items.opportunity: Coleman backfield role expansion; Bernard targets with Pittman out.

items.text: Packers ruled out WR Jayden Reed (neck).
items.implication: GB WR targets redistribute to Watson/Wicks/Doubs etc.
items.opportunity: Increased routes for Christian Watson and others.

items.text: Saints WR Chris Olave is active (hamstring); expected to play with no real docks per Levitan.
items.why: Official active; Rapoport and ETR expected, Levitan clean no docks.

items.text: Bengals QB Joe Burrow, listed questionable (back), is officially active vs Texans.
items.why: Schefter and Rapoport confirm will play/active after expected reports.
items.opportunity: Normal passing volume and red-zone for CIN skill players.

items.text: Projecting Ladd McConkey in with decent injury docks; RapSheet tone bullish, official status late; flak if plays. Puka true GTD. Olave clean no docks. Harvey->Coleman look. Pittman->Bernard.
items.why: Player-specific based on reports, Rap bullish on McConkey, clean Olave.
items.implication: DFS/main slate projections updated; docks for McConkey, full Olave, backups for outs.
items.opportunity: Coleman/Bernard opportunity expansion on absences; McConkey startable with caution.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers OUT (hamstring); opens door for Bateman etc.
items.why: ETR summary and Rapoport notes without Flowers need big Bateman game.
items.implication: Downgrade BAL pass game volume to Flowers; upgrade other WRs.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for remaining BAL WRs like Bateman.

items.text: Colts WR Michael Pittman OUT (foot); expecting look at Germie Bernard.
items.why: ETR/Levitan summary; Berry agrees Bernard stash for YAC/McCarthy fit.
items.implication: Target vacuum in IND; stash/upgrade depth WRs.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets/YAC for slot/depth like Bernard or Downs.

items.text: Weekend FF reports summary: McConkey GTD optimism+flak, Nacua GTD, Harvey not expected, Olave/Burrow/McMillan expected (snap count), Flowers/Pittman OUT. Last-minute LS scheduled.
items.why: Aggregated weekend reports for Sunday AM window.
items.implication: Core status board for lineup decisions; monitor inactives.
items.opportunity: Beneficiaries on outs as noted by Levitan.

items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua (hip) is a pre-game/true GTD for MNF vs Giants; trending concerns possible.
items.why: Schefter pre-game decision; ETR/Levitan true GTD, web notes declining likelihood.
items.implication: Monitor warmups closely; have Adams backup ready.
items.opportunity: If OUT, major upgrade Davante Adams targets/snaps; if IN limited.

items.text: Marshawn Lloyd first career TD; congrats to those who waited over 2 years.
items.why: In-game TD confirmation via Packers/Berry reaction.
items.implication: Possible role expansion or goal-line look in GB backfield.

items.text: Tua Tagovailoa inactive (among early actives list with Burrow/Olave/McMillan active).
items.implication: MIA backup QB; Waddle/Achane etc. may see scheme changes.
